newsitem.title: CANADA: CN seen selling Churchill rail to OmniTRAX.
newsitem.headline: CN seen selling Churchill rail to OmniTRAX.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co has agreed to sell more than 1,000 km of track extending to Canada's northernmost post of Churchill, Manitoba through northern Manitoba to Denver based OmniTRAX, a source close to the deal told Reuters on Tuesday.
"It's OmniTRAX. It's the best fit. They've got an interest in a port in Estonia and when the (Canadian) Wheat Board shipped to Russia they'd ship it to Estonia," the source said.
OmniTRAX, a unit of privately held Broe Industries, owns an interest in one of the largest grain handling ports among the Baltic states in Estonia, the source said.
